employee_documents_date_order.name: employee_documents_date_order
employee_documents_date_order.value: "employee_documents"."issue_date" IS NULL OR "employee_documents"."expiry_date" IS NULL OR "employee_documents"."expiry_date" >= "employee_documents"."issue_date"

profile_change_requests_review_consisten.name: profile_change_requests_review_consistency
profile_change_requests_review_consisten.value: "profile_change_requests"."status" = 'Pending' OR ("profile_change_requests"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "profile_change_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

employee_reporting_lines_current_primary.name: employee_reporting_lines_current_primary_unique
employee_reporting_lines_current_primary.where: "employee_reporting_lines"."is_primary" AND "employee_reporting_lines"."effective_to" IS NULL AND "employee_reporting_lines"."archived_at" IS NULL

leave_policies_negative_balance_consiste.name: leave_policies_negative_balance_consistency
leave_policies_negative_balance_consiste.value: ("leave_policies"."allow_negative_balance" AND "leave_policies"."max_negative_balance" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_policies"."max_negative_balance" >= 0) OR (NOT "leave_policies"."allow_negative_balance" AND "leave_policies"."max_negative_balance" IS NULL)

locations_clock_site_complete.name: locations_clock_site_complete
locations_clock_site_complete.value: NOT "locations"."is_clock_in_site" OR ("locations"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."radius_meters" IS NOT NULL)

projects_date_order.name: projects_date_order
projects_date_order.value: "projects"."end_date" IS NULL OR "projects"."start_date" IS NULL OR "projects"."end_date" > "projects"."start_date"

offboarding_cases_finalization_consisten.name: offboarding_cases_finalization_consistency
offboarding_cases_finalization_consisten.value: "offboarding_cases"."status" <> 'Completed' OR ("offboarding_cases"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "offboarding_cases"."finalized_by" IS NOT NULL AND "offboarding_cases"."financial_clearance_at" IS NOT NULL AND "offboarding_cases"."legal_clearance_at" IS NOT NULL)

offboarding_tasks_completion_consistency.name: offboarding_tasks_completion_consistency
offboarding_tasks_completion_consistency.value: "offboarding_tasks"."status" <> 'Completed' OR ("offboarding_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "offboarding_tasks"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL)

onboarding_tasks_completion_consistency.name: onboarding_tasks_completion_consistency
onboarding_tasks_completion_consistency.value: "onboarding_tasks"."status" <> 'Completed' OR ("onboarding_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_tasks"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL)

onboarding_tasks_evidence_consistency.name: onboarding_tasks_evidence_consistency
onboarding_tasks_evidence_consistency.value: NOT ("onboarding_tasks"."requires_evidence" AND "onboarding_tasks"."status" = 'Completed') OR "onboarding_tasks"."evidence_file_id" IS NOT NULL

workflow_tasks_assignment_present.name: workflow_tasks_assignment_present
workflow_tasks_assignment_present.value: "workflow_tasks"."assigned_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "workflow_tasks"."assigned_role" IS NOT NULL

candidate_preparation_runs_date_order.name: candidate_preparation_runs_date_order
candidate_preparation_runs_date_order.value: "candidate_preparation_runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "candidate_preparation_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "candidate_preparation_runs"."started_at" <= "candidate_preparation_runs"."completed_at"

job_offers_response_after_sent.name: job_offers_response_after_sent
job_offers_response_after_sent.value: "job_offers"."response_deadline" IS NULL OR "job_offers"."sent_date" IS NULL OR "job_offers"."response_deadline" >= "job_offers"."sent_date"

performance_reviews_lock_consistency.name: performance_reviews_lock_consistency
performance_reviews_lock_consistency.value: "performance_reviews"."locked_at" IS NULL OR "performance_reviews"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL

training_records_verification_consistenc.name: training_records_verification_consistency
training_records_verification_consistenc.value: NOT "training_records"."hr_verified" OR ("training_records"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_records"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_corrections_proposed_order.name: attendance_corrections_proposed_order
attendance_corrections_proposed_order.value: "attendance_corrections"."proposed_clock_in" IS NULL OR "attendance_corrections"."proposed_clock_out" IS NULL OR "attendance_corrections"."proposed_clock_out" >= "attendance_corrections"."proposed_clock_in"

attendance_exception_resolution_consiste.name: attendance_exception_resolution_consistency
attendance_exception_resolution_consiste.value: "attendance_exception_cases"."status" <> 'Resolved' OR ("attendance_exception_cases"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_exception_cases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND btrim(coalesce("attendance_exception_cases"."resolution_notes", '')) <> '')

attendance_records_punch_order.name: attendance_records_punch_order
attendance_records_punch_order.value: "attendance_records"."clock_in_at" IS NULL OR "attendance_records"."clock_out_at" IS NULL OR "attendance_records"."clock_out_at" >= "attendance_records"."clock_in_at"

overtime_claims_approval_consistency.name: overtime_claims_approval_consistency
overtime_claims_approval_consistency.value: "overtime_claims"."status" <> 'Approved' OR ("overtime_claims"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "overtime_claims"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL)

timesheets_approval_consistency.name: timesheets_approval_consistency
timesheets_approval_consistency.value: "timesheets"."approved_at" IS NULL OR "timesheets"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL

payroll_exceptions_ack_consistency.name: payroll_exceptions_ack_consistency
payroll_exceptions_ack_consistency.value: NOT "payroll_exceptions"."acknowledged" OR ("payroll_exceptions"."acknowledged_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_exceptions"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL)

travel_requests_pre_authorised_dual_appr.name: travel_requests_pre_authorised_dual_approval
travel_requests_pre_authorised_dual_appr.value: "travel_requests"."status" <> 'Pre-authorised' OR ("travel_requests"."hr_approval_status" = 'Approved' AND "travel_requests"."accounts_approval_status" = 'Approved' AND "travel_requests"."pre_authorised_at" IS NOT NULL)
